--Petitioners
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Shivam Rana with Mr. Kartikeya Naithani, 
learned Counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. B.S. Koranga, learned B.H. for the State.
3. Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned Counsel for 
UKSSSC-selecting body.
4. By means of this petition, petitioners, who 
responded to the advertisement dated 09.04.2025 for 
Group-C post, have challenged the Revised Answer Key 
issued on 21.07.2026.
5. It is contended by learned Counsel for petitioners 
that in Question Nos.1, 7 and 37 of Question Booklet 
Series-B, more than one options are correct; hence 
petitioners want the above question numbers to be 
deleted and to grant bonus marks to all the candidates. 
6. Learned Counsel for the selecting body is granted 
three weeks’ time to file counter affidavit.
7. List on 21.09.2026.
8. It is observed that the selection, if any, shall be 
subject to the final outcome of the writ petition. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 10.08.2026 R.Dang
